name: latent
description: Latent · 潜 — an agentic design language. Attention follows understanding, not activity.

scripts.gen: bun run gen:schema && bun run gen:tokens
scripts.verify: bun run validate "examples/**/*.json" && bun run verify:render
scripts.check:gen: bun run gen && git diff --exit-code -- schema/cognitive-state.schema.json packages/tokens/tokens.json
scripts.check: bun run check:gen && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run verify
scripts.build: bun run gen && bun run validate "examples/**/*.json" && bun run --filter @latent/site build
